purpose: Expose contextual actions, nested menus and controlled checkable choices from a single trigger.
behaviorProvider: Base UI ContextMenu and optional DirectionProvider with Aegis keyboard opening and Tab-exit handling.

requirements.statement: Support controlled open/onOpenChange or local defaultOpen and forward disabled to Base UI. The trigger receives tabIndex=0 and aria-disabled when disabled.
Handle the ContextMenu key and Shift+F10 on an enabled trigger, anchor opening near its bounds and focus the popup. Pointer/touch context behavior delegates to Base UI.
Compose actions, groups, separators, submenus, checkbox items and radio groups from DropdownMenuEntry data; delegate menu navigation and disabled-item behavior to Base UI.
Expose indeterminate checkboxes as aria-checked=mixed and request true on their next toggle. Checkbox activation keeps the menu open, while radio activation closes it.
On Tab, request immediate closure and allow normal tab movement from the trigger; suppress normal final-focus restoration for this exit so the next target can retain focus.
Use the trigger as the normal final-focus target and optional DirectionProvider for text direction. The deprecated modal prop is ignored in favor of the primitive native modal behavior.

Supply stable ids, meaningful labels and callbacks; update checked/radio values, handle asynchronous failures and provide confirmation for consequential actions. Shortcut labels do not register shortcuts.
Provide a suitable single trigger accepting refs and primitive props, and expose important actions through a discoverable alternative when users may not know a context menu exists.
Own pattern or component styling consumes trigger group tokens. Nested shared components retain their own group ownership; do not restyle their internals.

limitations: No asynchronous action pending/error lifecycle, authorization or automatic confirmation.
The deprecated modal prop does not change behavior.
The host must apply controlled open changes for Tab exit and other dismissal requests to take effect.
